people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Keilah
people.line: A town in the Shephelah of Judah, rescued by David

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul was told that David had come to Keilah. Saul said, “God has delivered him into my hand; for he is shut in by entering into a town that has gates and bars.”
translations.bsb: When Saul was told that David had gone to Keilah, he said, “God has delivered him into my hand, for he has trapped himself by entering a town with gates and bars.”
translations.kjv: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah. And Saul said, God hath delivered him into mine hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a town that hath gates and bars.
translations.asv: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah. And Saul said, God hath delivered him into my hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a town that hath gates and bars.
